svg.title: InferRSI Knowledge Architecture
svg.desc: Canonical sources feed source-pinned generated projections and explicit read/write authorities. Legacy search, default Collect and optional lexical selection/context remain separate. Exact-revision reads return complete required resources; the agent decides authorized use. Frozen evidence and reviewed matrices retain their ownership.
svg.text: Canonical sources → build & authorities → retrieval → exact reads & explicit use

g.text: Existing IDs, tiers, scope and sources
Frozen evidence stays at its owner
Imported state belongs to the record
Adaptations need a distinct derived ID
1 full core; score ↓, then qualified ref
Optional owner files selected by cue
Unavailable old bytes never use latest
Required set over budget: omit context
Other links still need exact reads

svg.text: Reviewed content + matrices; store candidates are not repository coverage.
